# pantechdynamics_dynamic_ip (Data Source)

Reads the Dynamic IP configuration, current rotating outbound public address, and recent rotation events of an instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the Dynamic IP status, current outbound address, and recent rotation
# events for an instance.
data "pantechdynamics_dynamic_ip" "worker" {
  instance_id = pantechdynamics_instance.worker.id
}

output "current_outbound_address" {
  value = data.pantechdynamics_dynamic_ip.worker.current_address
}

output "recent_rotations" {
  value = data.pantechdynamics_dynamic_ip.worker.events
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) Id of the instance, starting with vm_.

### Read-Only

- `connections` (String) How open outbound connections behave on rotation: "keep" or "move".
- `current_address` (String) The rotating public IPv4 address currently used for outbound traffic, or null before it is ready or while falling back to the instance's own address.
- `events` (Attributes List) Recent Dynamic IP rotation events, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))
- `failure_reason` (String) Explanation when state is "failed" or "degraded", or null otherwise.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the Dynamic IP configuration, equal to instance_id.
- `last_rotated_at` (String) When the outbound address last rotated, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `next_rotation_at` (String) When the next scheduled rotation is due, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `on_demand` (Boolean) Whether on-demand rotation is allowed for this instance.
- `on_demand_limit` (Number) Maximum number of on-demand rotations allowed per 24 hours.
- `on_demand_used` (Number) Number of on-demand rotations performed in the last 24 hours.
- `schedule` (String) How often the outbound public address rotates: "every_12_hours", "daily", "weekly", or "monthly".
- `state` (String) Current lifecycle state of Dynamic IP: "enabling", "active", "degraded", "disabling", "off", or "failed".
- `surcharge_percent` (Number) Percentage added to the instance's hourly price while Dynamic IP is enabled.

<a id="nestedatt--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events`

Read-Only:

- `degraded` (Boolean) Whether Dynamic IP was degraded when this event occurred.
- `from_address` (String) Previous rotating public IPv4 address, or null.
- `kind` (String) Event type: "enabled", "scheduled", "on_demand", "failover", "handover", or "disabled".
- `occurred_at` (String) When the event occurred, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `to_address` (String) New rotating public IPv4 address, or null.
